submission.bindingBasis: The planning evidence observed a clean workspace (no unreviewed local work, ready to close). The owner contract allows workspace.close to omit expectedSourceStateDigest, so we can close without binding to a digests that may have shifted. No reobservation is strictly needed since closing without CAS does not depend on current state remaining identical.
submission.rationale: The intended consequence is to close the workspace and release local materialization. The owner action contract explicitly permits workspace.close to omit expectedSourceStateDigest, which means we do not need to bind to the planning-time digest. Since the observed state was clean and ready to close, and the close can be performed unbound, there is no justification to HOLD or REOBSERVE. ACT_UNBOUND avoids a false or duplicate consequence by not over-binding while still executing the intended close.
